a_before_b.rationale: Defining evaluation methods and data (A) encompasses selecting appropriate evaluation methods (B), so mastering A is not required before learning how to select methods; B is a component skill within A.

b_before_a.rationale: Selecting appropriate evaluation methods for different criteria (B) is a foundational skill needed before a learner can meaningfully define evaluation methods and data, including annotating data and slicing it for production slices (A).
